description: Lake Victoria Basin Health Monitoring is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features, Water", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This dataset for Lake Victoria includes the following parameters: 1. Ecological water quality parameters (including Chlorophyll-a surface concentration, Suspended Particulate Matter (SPM) and Lake Surface Temperature (LST)), 2. Monitoring of the proliferation of macro-algae (water hyacinth index from optical data, water hyacinth likelihood index from radar data, and Floating Vegetation), 3. Coverage: Kenya, Uganda. It has 1 file in Other. The portal files it under Physical features, Water. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
